verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents on-request opening and scanning of mail, with a stated turnaround of usually within 6 business hours, which beats a same- or next-business-day requirement. PDF output is only documented for registered-agent legal documents, and there is no evidence that scans are OCR'd or text-searchable. Tagging is a different feature and does not count as searchable PDFs. Missing for 10: evidence that general mailbox scans are delivered as PDFs, OCR/text-searchable scans, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the turnaround.

support.subject: As an operator, my mail is opened and scanned to searchable PDFs with a stated turnaround — same or next business day — not just an envelope photo

citations.quote: Request to have your mail opened and scanned for convenient online access. Mail scanning requests are usually processed within 6 business hours.
All forwarded documents are scanned and stored as PDF files on the cloud.
All legal documents served are scanned and available online the same day they are received
